claims.text: When a Pod is deleted, the kubelet has the container runtime send TERM (SIGTERM) to the main process in each container, with a grace period; many container runtimes send the image's STOPSIGNAL value instead when the image defines a different one.

claims.text: AWS's EKS best-practices guide says that when a Pod is terminated the Kubernetes API notifies the kubelet and the EndpointSlice controller at the same time, creating a race in which new requests can still be sent to the container after SIGTERM until iptables rules are updated, and recommends a PreStop hook that delays SIGTERM, such as a simple Exec handler running sleep 10.
